name: Aizen Yukihito
source:
A sadistic redhead with glasses. He is very interested in the spunky [url=/c1757]Mirai[/url] and wants her to be his sex toy, but Mirai wants nothing to do with him. He and [url=/c1839]Yumeko[/url]  find [url=/c1831]Yoshijirou[/url] beating up the students in a line of defense and decides his and the Class 2-B's punishment.
